# Gemini Host Pointer

The generated current Gemini host contract is `GEMINI.md`. Regenerate it from
the registry-backed source with `npm run build:distributions` and verify drift
with `npm run validate:distributions`.

This compatibility file grants no alternate authority or execution route.
Follow the global/estate/repository `AGENTS.md` order. Use CStar kernel MCP
first, direct stdio only, and the current CoS/Forge/Researcher architecture.
PMTs are project information repositories, MM is legacy, AutoBot/TCP are
retired, Augury/Council are advisory, TokenPath is quarantined, and persona is
style-only.
